mapping: Both Core facades use the same native Google streamGenerateContent/SSE construction;no upstream/Core JSON response is inferred. Explicit raw enabled/HIGH/max64 maps to explicit Core high/max64,not default/simple/context allocation. Native six ordered blocks include signed-empty text/thought,visible signed text/thinking and a signed function call. Contiguous streaming retains the last nonempty signature. Whole native body/contents/tools arrays,including systemInstruction user role and output/error/tool IDs,are independently compared. Same-owner IDs retain slash;foreign provider/API/model/missing-API IDs normalize slash to underscore. Foreign visible thinking becomes text;opaque/signature-only data disappears;failed producers grant no replay. Invalid or expurgated base64 is removed on replay,not authenticated. Original Google/Vertex and other Zen APIs are not authority for this acquisition.
limits: Fresh independent pinned OpenCode Zen Google raw stream execution over owned HTTPS/SSE,seven actual G profiles only. Eighteen A/thirty R/twenty-eight C/two T unexecuted in this batch;preceding A/R evidence remains separate. Supplied synthetic key/max64/thinking enabled HIGH/cache-none/no-session/network-none/maxRetries0 and reference-only transform/JIT argv are not streamSimple/default/context/reserve,canonical application flags,service/account/crypto/billing/tokenizer/media/host acceptance. Thought signatures are synthetic base64 carriers,not cryptographic proofs. Whole body/contents/tool arrays must be compared without filtering. Correct normalized replay context is passed directly,not normalized twice. No Core implementation,private grant or dependency/image preparation follows from reference acquisition alone. All70 initial calls remain selected;14 additional error/empty-result requests reuse actual initial SDK seeds,not seven new seed calls. Both immutable programs/captures/TLS sets remain source-separated.
